audit_items.proof_trace: The rebate calculation uses cascading proportional arithmetic: referee_rebates = floor(initial_fee * referee_bps / 10000), then referrer_rebates = floor((initial_fee - referee_rebates) * referrer_bps / 10000). Since referrer_rebates ≤ (initial_fee - referee_rebates), their sum ≤ initial_fee by algebraic identity. Both BPS values are strictly enforced < 10000 at all write paths (update_referral_params asserts bps < DENOMINATOR; default values are 400/1000), leaving no bypass.
